responsibility: Provides the primary RTL machine description for the SPU processor. It defines instruction attributes and pipeline reservations, unspec codes, mode iterators and attributes, core instruction patterns and expanders, branch and special-register operations, stack protector support, and even the target’s simplified atomic patterns, making it the central instruction-selection and scheduling specification that recog, reload, the scheduler, and builtin expansion use for SPU code generation.
same_name_distinction: This is the main RTL machine-description for general SPU instruction selection, attributes, reservations, and core patterns, including non-builtin operations and simplified atomics. Unlike spu-builtins.md it is not focused on the intrinsic-specific builtin layer, and unlike spu.c/spu.h/spu.opt it is not C code, a header contract, or an option table.
